draft_policy: Skip the heavy Full Regression job while the pull request is draft.
synchronize_policy: Every synchronize event for a non-draft pull request creates a new exact candidate and cancels the previous in-progress Full Regression run for that pull request.
concurrency_policy: One Full Regression run per pull request or manual candidate; cancel-in-progress is true.
required_authority_behavior: The permanent trigger only selects the candidate. F7-03 reuses or dispatches twenty-one exact-candidate workflows: TP-CI-02 remains the serial two-authority Kassa cluster, fourteen authorities formerly serialized inside TP-CI-03/04/05/07 run as standalone workflows in parallel, and the six existing standalone/schema/supporting/frontend authorities remain required.
